Based on the graph, which of the following statement(s) are valid? (i) People in their twenties are the most computer-literate among all age groups. (ii) Women lag behind in the ability to use computers across age groups. (iii) There are more people in their twenties than teenagers. steps_tex: Check each statement against both bars of its age group.
item.answer_tex: Valid: (i): twenties are highest for both women and men; (ii): female is below male in every group; (v): seniors $2$% and $4$% are both under $10$%. Not valid: (iii): percentages say nothing about how many people are in each group; (iv): thirties $14$% and $25$%, so not more than a quarter overall; (vi): twenties $26$% and $37$%, far from half.
